gloss: end of a performance; curtain fall

definitions.gloss: end of a performance; curtain fall
definitions.explanation: The conclusion of a play, concert, or other live performance. Used in theater and event contexts to indicate when a show has finished.

examples.japanese: {終演|しゅうえん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What time does the performance end?

examples.japanese: {終演|しゅうえん}{後|ご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ロビー→ロビー：26995_robii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦サイン→サイン：03846_sain⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There will be an autograph session in the lobby after the performance ends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧⟦{遅|おく}れて→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧{終演|しゅうえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The show reached its curtain fall thirty minutes later than scheduled.

notes:
USAGE:
Used primarily in theater, music, and event contexts. Often appears on programs and schedules to indicate the finish time. The pair ⟦{開演|かいえん}→開演：23500_kaien⟧ (start of performance) and {終演|しゅうえん} (end of performance) are commonly seen together on event listings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {終演|しゅうえん}{後|ご} (after the performance ends)
- {終演|しゅうえん}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (end time of a performance)
- {終演|しゅうえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to reach the curtain fall)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧: general ending or conclusion — broader usage, not limited to performances
- ⟦{終焉|しゅうえん}→終焉：13839_shuuen⟧: end, demise — homophone but refers to the end of something in a grander or more literary sense
